card.name: Linking words in physics and math text
card.fires_on: Small linking words and word pieces (on, of, the, can, quasi) inside passages about physics or mathematics, where the next word could be physics or math terms.

modes.description: Words like on or correct inside descriptions of mathematics teaching or logic.
